about_short_description.short_description: Vanta is a trust management platform that automates compliance and risk management.

product.name: Vanta AI Trust Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing security, compliance, risk, and trust programs through automated workflows, continuous monitoring, evidence collection, and AI-assisted actions.

product.name: Automated Compliance
product.description: Software that automates compliance workflows, evidence collection, control monitoring, and readiness activities across more than 35 security, privacy, and AI governance frameworks.

product.name: Continuous GRC
product.description: A governance, risk, and compliance solution for continuous controls monitoring, real-time alerts, compliance management, and integrated risk workflows.

product.name: Vendor Risk Management
product.description: A vendor risk management solution for onboarding suppliers, conducting security reviews, monitoring third-party risk continuously, and maintaining vendor oversight.

product.name: Questionnaire Automation
product.description: An AI-assisted solution that automates responses to customer security questionnaires and streamlines security reviews during sales and procurement processes.

product.name: Trust Center
product.description: A customer-facing portal for publishing an organization’s compliance status, security documentation, policies, and trust information.
